description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “Timeless,” a secret gem in prime Rosemary Beach location. This stunning property blends upscale design with impeccable comfort, featuring a private courtyard, 2 primary suites and a chef's kitchen in the main cottage, plus a charming carriage house for 2 more guests! Just steps from 4 resort pools and boutique shops, this home comes with 4 beach cruiser bikes for effortless exploration. Learn more below...*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Prime Location: 3-min away from the heated pool and fitness center. Within walking distance from the beach, 4 resort pools, and boutique shops.Elegant Design: Thoughtfully designed interiors featuring premium finishes and a functional layout between 2 homes.Included Carriage House: A fully equipped, self-contained space ideal for added privacy or hosting guests in comfort.Private Courtyard: Screened in porch, gas grill, and outdoor shower for serene outdoor moments.Chef’s Kitchen: Fully equipped with premium appliances and everything needed to cook and serve your family favorites. Plus, an additional kitchenette in the carriage house.Baldwin Baby Grand Piano: Elegantly placed for music lovers and perfect for creating memorable moments.Beach Perks: 4 adult cruiser bikes included for breezy trips to the beach or exploring hidden Rosemary boardwalks.Parking: Private garage includes parking for 2 vehicles.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐"The property was exactly as described, making check-in a breeze. Beautiful design and convenient location close to shops and the beach!" – Michael S.⭐"Timeless was just that! We loved the gorgeous home, especially the courtyard and the carriage house. It was perfect for our group!" – Debbie P.⭐“Location is unbeatable—a quick bike ride to the beach and town square. The kitchen was so well-stocked! Highly recommend staying here!” – Gabriela T.*** LIVING AREAS ***Experience timeless luxury and family-friendly comfort in this thoughtfully crafted home, nestled in the exclusive Rosemary Beach community. Designed for relaxation and entertainment, the seamless open floor plan features a spacious living room with designer furnishings, a plush sofa, a wall-mounted flat-screen TV, and a stunning Baldwin Baby Grand Piano. The surround sound system lets you enjoy your favorite tunes throughout different rooms, while the private courtyard and expertly designed interiors create a chic retreat. Plus, the cozy intimate living area in the carriage house provides an additional space to unwind and relax in comfort.Comfortable seating for intimate gatherings or movie nightsWall-mounted flat-screen TVStunning designer furniture and refined interiorsElegant Baldwin Baby Grand PianoSurround sound systemCozy and private living area in the carriage house*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Cook like a pro in a chef’s kitchen that’s every foodie’s dream! Outfitted with premium appliances, including a built-in ice maker and wet bar, this kitchen makes cooking and entertaining truly effortless. Gather the family around the reclaimed wood dining table with seating for 8, and enjoy delicious meals together. Plus, a convenient kitchenette in the carriage house offers additional space for meal prep or quick snacks.High-end appliances for gourmet cookingWet bar with built-in ice maker for ultimate convenienceLarge reclaimed wood dining table set for 8 guests, plus 3 at the kitchen barKitchenette in the carriage house with full-size refrigerator, microwave, coffee-maker, dishwasher and dining for 4*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Step into your private courtyard, surrounded by lush greenery—an outdoor sanctuary perfect for grilling, dining, or simply unwinding. The screened porch provides a cozy spot for morning coffee, with a dining and lounging area complete with ceiling fans for added comfort. The outdoor shower is perfect for rinsing off after a day at the beach.Courtyard - Surrounded by lush vegetation for privacy and tranquilityScreened-in porch for all-weather relaxation, dining, and loungingGas grill for delicious summer barbecuesOutdoor shower for post-beach convenience*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st FloorGuest Bathroom: Conveniently accessible from both inside and outside of the cottage – perfect for rinsing off after the beach2nd FloorPrimary King Suite: Luxurious King-size bed, vaulted ceilings, private balcony, smart TV, and en-suite bathroom with double vanity and tiled walk-in showerKing Guest Suite: King-size bed, vaulted ceilings, private balcony, smart TV, and en-suite bathroom with tub/shower comboCarriage HouseQueen-size bed, sofa, wall-mounted TV and bathroom with single vanity and walk-in shower*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Rosemary Beach isn’t just a destination; it’s an experience. This beachside community includes award-winning architecture, secret boardwalks, and endless charm. The emerald water creates a stunning backdrop for family photos, while gorgeous sunsets set the stage for relaxing evenings. With 2.3 miles of footpaths and lush green fields perfect for family time, every moment here becomes unforgettable.3-Minute Walk to Fitness Center, Racquet Club and Heated Sky Pool4-Minute Walk to Cabana PoolRosemary Beach – 9-minute walk or quick 4-minute bike rideLocal Shops & Dining at Barrett Square – 3-minute walkRosemary Beach Community: Beachside Destination with Award-Winning ArchitectureMultiple Parks & Greens: Playgrounds, Splash Pad, Butterfly Park, Boardwalks, and Fountains4 RESORT POOLSBarbados Pool: Gulf-side, French West Indies style with a fountainCoquina Pool: Gulf-side, with a relaxing negative edge overflowSky Pool: Park-side, indoor, heated year-round with radiant heated decking in winterCabana Pool: Park-side, cabana-style with a children’s pool & playground nearby*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesLSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.The living room fireplace is NOT for guest use.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 58374STRO #: STR-058374
